name: POST /api/auth/register - Create a LeadFlow account
description: Registers a LeadFlow user and returns a signed session token in the same response. This is the auth bootstrap: it PROVIDES the token every protected endpoint consumes, so it is deliberately unauthenticated. ProjexCloud is the identity authority for LeadFlow; the local users table is the session-bound projection this endpoint writes. Email must be unique and is stored lower-cased; password must be at least 8 characters and is bcrypt-hashed before storage. MUST-46 note: password resolves from the test_password config variable rather than from a captured value, deliberately. A password is never present in any response body, so NO endpoint anywhere can produce it and no captureResponse can capture it - this is the genuine producer-less case the rule permits. It is not an entity id, so the VAR-FOR-FK antipattern does not apply. The variable is declared per environment so a dev secret is never carried into staging or production. Login must present the SAME value, so both definitions reference that one config variable. QA: run this before any protected endpoint - it is the producer of the auth.register.response.data.token key.

testCases.name: Reject a password shorter than eight characters

errorCases.when: email is missing or malformed, password is absent or shorter than 8 characters, or any supplied field exceeds its maximum length
an account already exists with the supplied email
a username was supplied and another account already holds it
